title: Balloon Burst Bounty
commonMistakes: Omitting the value-1 sentinels at both ends
Reasoning about the first burst instead of the last burst in an interval
Using stale neighbor values after other balloons have burst
Iterating intervals in the wrong order so subproblems are not ready
followUps: How would you reconstruct an optimal burst order?
What changes if bursting a balloon also awards a bonus for adjacent pairs?
Can the DP be reduced below quadratic space?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
